purpose: FORWARD live-evidence correction to the QF-MVP-40-R8B actual-staging template creation authority. A read-only dry run against the exact actual-staging identity proved that the operator's asset-scope layer imposed a SEND-eligibility precondition (phone code_verification_status = VERIFIED) on an operation that cannot send. This artifact records the live evidence, the narrowed invariant and the fences that were deliberately left intact.
privacy: Meta asset identities appear ONLY as SHA-256 digests of the raw id strings. No token, app secret, verify token, phone number or remote template id appears here.

not_a_historical_rewrite.statement: Nothing historical is amended. R8B had never executed, so there is no execution record to correct. This is a forward change to an unconsumed authority, recorded before its first use.

pre_correction_state.statement: The R8B validator passed 101/101 offline before any live execution. The defect was NOT a coding error the offline suite could have caught: the suite encoded the same incorrect environment assumption the operator did, using a VERIFIED phone fixture. Only live evidence could expose it.

subscribed_app_set_proven.note: Both ids were independently proven and are supplied only through the owner's external attestation. Neither is hard-coded, and no display name is trusted.

authority_consumption.statement: No prior R8B mutation authority has been consumed. Zero POSTs occurred during discovery, and the operator remains unexecuted.

root_cause.defect: code_verification_status === 'VERIFIED' was a mandatory asset-scope condition. Any other value pushed PHONE_NOT_CODE_VERIFIED, which made readLiveAssets().ok false, which made proveAssets() return SHARED_OR_UNKNOWN, which is a hard stop.
root_cause.why_it_is_wrong: R8B creates a template through the WABA-level endpoint POST /{WABA-ID}/message_templates. That endpoint accepts no phone number, and a template's existence, category and approval are properties of the WABA, not of any sender. Phone registration and send eligibility are therefore not authority this operator needs or exercises.
root_cause.why_it_bit_now: The dedicated Meta TEST phone on the actual staging WABA legitimately reports NOT_VERIFIED. The historical mixed-identity environment corrected by QF-MVP-40-R8 had pointed at a production phone, which was VERIFIED — so the incorrect precondition was never exercised against the real staging asset until the identity boundary was repaired.
root_cause.classifier_note: classifyMetaAssetScope never inspected phone verification. The gate existed solely in readLiveAssets, and PHONE_NOT_CODE_VERIFIED was referenced nowhere else in the repository.

behavioral_change.removed: code_verification_status as a blocking asset-scope condition, and the now-unreachable PHONE_NOT_CODE_VERIFIED failure constant.
behavioral_change.added: codeVerificationStatus is returned as an OBSERVED field and printed by the CLI as an explicitly advisory line. ADVISORY_PHONE_FIELDS names the fields this operator reports but never gates on.
behavioral_change.statement: Phone verification remains fully relevant to phone registration and sending paths. It is removed only as an unrelated prerequisite for WABA-level template creation.

fences_explicitly_retained: exactly ONE phone must exist on the WABA
that phone id must equal the pinned actual-staging phone identity via proveAssets / classifyMetaAssetScope
configured App, WABA and Phone must all match ACTUAL_STAGING_IDENTITY_DIGESTS
the production deny list remains an independent and mandatory layer
live WABA must equal the exact actual-staging WABA
live subscribed-app set must EXACTLY equal the owner-attested set — no extra, no missing
staging asset proof must be external, fresh (<=15 min), tamper-evident, stage-bound to TEMPLATE_CREATION and bound to the exact source HEAD
canonical payload fingerprint remains pinned to c6e95a38dde899f717999520082feddf4c91f2a33c84650c72538ef2c111199a
exact-name remote lookup must be ABSENT before any POST
both execution flags remain mandatory (--execute and --owner-authorized-once-actual-staging-create)
no retry after an ambiguous POST
no readiness, canary, mapping or webhook authority

untouched_send_capable_paths.statement: Phone code verification remains enforced wherever sending or readiness is actually at stake. These files are byte-identical to the merged QF-MVP-40-R8 line.

validator.invariant_replaced: A13 'an unverified phone fails' -> A13 'an unverified phone PASSES — exact identity, exact WABA, exact attested set'
validator.default_fixture_changed_to_measured_live: code_verification_status NOT_VERIFIED / quality_rating GREEN, so the whole suite now runs against the real environment contract
new_rules: A13  unverified phone passes with exact identity + exact WABA + exact attested set
A13a the default fixture really is the measured live state
A13b a VERIFIED phone still passes — the relaxation is not an inversion
A13c every code_verification_status value is accepted; none is a gate
A13d a WRONG phone id still fails, whatever its verification state
A13e the PRODUCTION phone still fails, even when VERIFIED
A13f an unreadable phones response still fails
A13g a phones response with no data array still fails
A13h an EMPTY phone list still fails
A13i the operator source contains NO code_verification_status gate
A13j the field is still observed and reported, not silently dropped
A13k quality_rating likewise remains advisory, not a gate

authorities_explicitly_not_granted.statement: This correction is a repository change only. R8B remains dry-run by default, unexecuted, and still requires both exact execution flags plus a fresh stage-bound owner attestation.
